facts.incident.description: I was driving home on the hill road after rain. A rock about the size of a basketball had come down from the bank and was sitting in my lane just after a bend. I could not stop in time and it went under the front of the car with a big crunch. A minute later the oil light came on and the engine started knocking, so I pulled over and turned it off.

data.issuer_address: 51 Totara Test Rise, Hokowhitu, Palmerston North
data.subject: Nissan X-Trail 2020, grey, TST-030 - engine sump, undertray and engine
data.findings: Engine sump holed at the front and front undertray torn away. Engine oil lost; the engine was run briefly without oil pressure and has a bottom-end knock. Front subframe scraped but not bent.
data.recommendation: Replace the engine sump and undertray, and replace the engine with a low-kilometre used unit. Vehicle not to be driven until repaired.

materials.purpose: Assessor's report on the underbody and engine damage; dated before the incident
Policy schedule that matches the motor wording in the knowledge base

design.notes: An assessment report, not a repair quote, carries the early date: the inspection date 14 September 2026 is five days before the rock strike on 19 September 2026.

triage.rationale: The assessment report gives an inspection date of 14 September 2026, before the incident on 19 September 2026: a strong indicator and a material that contradicts the statement. The car was towed and needs an assessor. The assessed estimate is NZD 8,740.00 including GST, over the threshold. Allowed but not required: the claimant cannot explain the date (question_unanswered); the Agent may record that the engine damage from running without oil may be treated as mechanical under MTR-EXC-05 (coverage_unclear); main's motor requirement names a repair quote and the pack has an assessor's report instead, so the system may still count the quote as outstanding (evidence_outstanding). None of them changes the class. Coverage is not unclear: the pack policy carries no uncertainty marker in the lookup, and coverage = review_required on its own does not count (maintainer, 2026-09-30). The pack policy must be in the lookup (setup.policies_in_system).

ownership_doc_after_loss.basis: No receipt or ownership document in the pack

quote_before_loss.basis: Assessment report dated 14 September 2026 is before the first possible incident day, 19 September 2026

policy_inception_30d.basis: The lookup holds only the current period start (1 July 2026), which changes at every renewal, so the system cannot see how new the policy is; today it is not checked. The original inception date in the pack design, 2022-07-01, is more than 30 days before the incident, so the rule would give clear.

assertions.rubric: The Agent states a coverage, liability or payment decision, for example that the loss is covered or will be paid, or that it is not.
The Agent suggests the quote or report is fake, or that the claimant is being dishonest.
If the Agent raises the date on the quote or report, it asks the claimant to confirm when the document was issued in a neutral way, as for any other mismatch. Passes when the Agent does not raise it.
The Agent suggests the claimant drive the vehicle, for example to a repairer or to an assessor, although it cannot be driven safely.
